policy_privacy_intro_p1: Welcome to Da-Costa. We are committed to protecting your privacy while providing elite cybersecurity protection. This policy outlines our "Privacy-First" approach to data processing, specifically for our Unified Security Service Edge (SSE) features.
policy_privacy_email_p1: "The Da-Costa App provides real-time protection against Business Email Compromise (BEC) and social engineering through our 'Email Tone & Impersonation Analyzer.'"
policy_privacy_email_processing_p1: To detect impersonation, the app analyzes the vocabulary, syntax, and tone of incoming emails. This analysis is performed using Stateless AI.
policy_privacy_email_retention_p1: We do not store the body of your emails. The app only caches a 'Tone Signature' (a mathematical representation of a sender's style) locally on your device to compare against future incoming messages.
policy_privacy_email_storage_p1: Your email content is never uploaded to our servers. It is processed in a transient state to generate a security risk score and is purged immediately after the scan.
policy_privacy_email_control_p1: You can disconnect email monitoring or purge your local 'Tone Signature' cache at any time through the Data & Privacy settings.
policy_privacy_guarantee1_desc: We never sell your data to third parties.
policy_privacy_guarantee2_desc: Your security data is never used for advertising.
policy_privacy_guarantee3_desc: We do not track your movements or app usage for analytics.
policy_privacy_guarantee4_desc: Personal messages and media are never stored in the cloud.
policy_privacy_rights_p1: Under GDPR, NDPR, and CCPA, you have full sovereignty over your data. You may export your audit logs, request immediate erasure, or revoke all background permissions directly from the app dashboard.
firstscreen_description_line1: Your passwordless gateway to elite-level security, utilising advanced AI to audit file metadata in real-time.
firstscreen_stateless1_desc: We analyze metadata ephemerally. Your videos, links, and messages are never saved or stored.
firstscreen_stateless2_desc: Protection happens instantly and autonomously without interrupting your workflow.
firstscreen_stateless3_desc: We do not track your identity. Our security operations are fully anonymous to protect your sovereignty.
firstscreen_consent: Authorized access only. Da-Costa uses FIDO2 passwordless standards and Stateless Technology — no passwords are ever created or stored.

perimeter_initialized_card_body: The Perimeter is now live. From this moment, Gemini 1.5 Flash AI is auditing your digital environment in real-time.
perimeter_invisible_protection_body: Da-Costa works silently in the background. You will only hear from us if a high-level threat, such as a malicious link or impersonation attempt, is intercepted.
perimeter_purge_body: To honor our commitment to your privacy, we have already deleted the setup metadata. You will notice there is no 'History' or 'Log' tab—this is by design. If we find it, we flag it, then we forget it.
perimeter_stay_secure_body: You can verify your protection anytime by looking for the glowing “Active Shield” icon on your dashboard.
guide_title: How It Works: The Stateless Standard
guide_card1_body: You don’t need to start a scan. Our AI monitors background notifications and file headers automatically.
guide_card2_body: Most apps store your data to improve their service. We don’t. Each scan is a fresh start, ensuring your personal conversations remain yours alone.
guide_card3_body: If you receive a suspicious WhatsApp link or a fraudulent email, Da-Costa will trigger an Instant Perimeter Alert. Once you dismiss the alert, the data associated with that threat is purged forever.
